scope: declared finite retention fixture; no isotope or physical decay identification
candidate_reference: the existing two Q4 square routes and reference square, with admitted return certificates
formation_reason: fixed preparation offset makes candidate minus reference bip count one when a new reference return has completed and the next candidate return is pending
background: one admitted recurring 3:4:6 field, advanced and contacted each round; a separate intervention holds its second new return pending
parent: certified outer closure retaining the evolving candidate inner wave; reference and background are external coupled fields
protocol: complete the actual reference return and bound cross-return; complete the background return and bound cross-return; decide with the preceding committed response state; execute candidate return or open exit; commit response and fold the next outer return
lag: unwrapped candidate minus sender bip counts in the committed prefix, zero phase bias; orientation sign is separate
reflection: neutral directional reflection in baseline; a separate reverse-direction witness control adds one reflected hinge count per contact
pressure: one participating channel per sender; C3=1; rho is the last-two-contact RCD duration, clipped in its declared integer count domain to the frozen window length
response: for each accepted candidate returned response, signed current adds sum(rho*lag*orientation); carried burden adds sum(rho*abs(lag)); immutable contributions retain both cross-return witnesses
normalization: u is the structural RD of the certified reference square cross-return; report and diagnostic coordinates divide raw response and burden by the same frozen u

capacity.status: declared fixture capacity, not inferred nuclear capacity

loss: positive-weight open exit follows two actual H1 edges; a computed exoshedding record binds the selected load and prior outer certificate; exposure preserves the retained candidate wave; absorption is only the existing declared diagnostic loss predicate

controls.burden_feedback_off: after two committed responses, gate their use in the next decision to zero; preserve the complete signed and burden histories
controls.burden_latest_response_window: only the most recent committed response group participates; earlier events remain in retained history with an explicit window-exclusion disposition
controls.burden_background_pending: at the second measured reference return, commit the first H1 edge of the background return and hold completion pending through the horizon; contacts bind its existing recurring prefix
controls.orientation: ++ and --, +- and -+ use opposite current orientations while preserving actual cadence comparisons
controls.direction: recompute forward and reverse RCD from separately bound directional traces
controls.passive_observer: turn optional observation copies on/off without changing transition inputs

freeze: written before first execution; all common choices remain fixed across the declared comparisons
